name: Long Call Ladder (Bull Call Ladder)
summary: Buy 1 lower call, sell 1 middle call, sell 1 higher call; a bull call spread financed by an extra short call, which leaves unlimited risk above the top strike.

legs.strike_rule: K1 = ATM or slightly ITM, call delta 0.50-0.60

when_to_use: COMPLETENESS / LEVEL 4: IV rank > 50 with a target price between K2 and K3. Two short calls against one long leaves one uncovered - unlimited risk above the upper breakeven. Under Level 3, use a call butterfly or a call BWB instead.
max_profit: (K2 - K1) x 100 - net debit (or + credit), flat between K2 and K3
breakevens: lower = K1 + debit/100; upper = K3 + (K2 - K1) - debit/100

greeks.delta: positive at entry, sharply negative above K3
greeks.theta: positive once spot is above K1

entry_rules: BLOCKED AT LEVEL 3: the K3 short call is uncovered; requires Alpaca level 4. The router must reject this slug at Level 3.
Level 4 version: IV rank >= 50; K3 delta <= 0.20; hard-coded protective stop above the upper breakeven.
Level-3 substitute: buy a fourth call above K3 to create a call condor, or drop to a call BWB.
management_rules: Level 4 only: close at 50% of max profit.
Level 4 only: close immediately if spot trades above K3, and always close at 21 DTE.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: two short calls, one uncovered; flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short call is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before every ex-dividend date when either short call is ITM.
assignment_risk: Assignment on both shorts delivers -200 shares per unit, hedged by only 1 long call; the residual is a naked 100-share short at unlimited risk.
buying_power: Naked short call margin on the uncovered contract plus the debit spread cost.
common_mistakes: Trading it at Level 3 by miscounting the legs; believing the profit plateau between K2 and K3 makes it safe.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
bias_note: moderately bullish with a capped target; short-vol
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
